name: [NEW] Wall Hop Tower to Admin
desc:
Wall Hop Tower to Admin is a skill based tower to get free admin! 🎮 

❓ Think you can beat the tower and get admin? 👉 Press play to find out!

🏆  Beat the tower, become admin. and rule the server! 🏆 

Each stage gradually becomes more challenging 🧗‍♂️📈, encouraging careful movement and steady progress 🚶‍♂️. 
One wrong move can send you falling back down ⬇️ — so stay calm 😌, take your time ⏳, and plan every jump 🦶.

Can you stay focused and reach the top? 🏔️✨
Climb carefully and conquer the tower and unlock admin powers 🏆
